Operating from its prestigious headquarters at 363 East 42nd Street in the vibrant heart of New York City, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. stands as a beacon of innovation and reliability in the global chemical industry. Specializing in the development, synthesis, and supply of high-purity chemical compounds, Standardpharm is a pivotal partner to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences sectors. Our mission is to accelerate scientific discovery and improve global health outcomes by providing the foundational molecules that power next-generation therapeutics and diagnostics.

At the core of Standardpharm’s operations is an unwavering commitment to excellence. We are a premier supplier of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), advanced intermediates, and a diverse portfolio of specialty chemicals essential for research and manufacturing. Every product that leaves our facilities is governed by the most stringent quality control protocols, ensuring it meets and exceeds the rigorous regulatory standards required by our partners, from emerging biotech startups to multinational pharmaceutical giants. Our New York-based research and development team collaborates with leading academic and industrial institutions to pioneer novel synthetic pathways, driving efficiency and sustainability in chemical manufacturing.

From our strategic vantage point in Manhattan, we manage a sophisticated global supply chain, ensuring timely and dependable delivery to clients across the world. Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is more than just a chemical supplier; we are a dedicated partner in progress, committed to setting the highest standard in chemical science to help build a healthier, more advanced world.
